rubrics.justification: Provides detailed morphology, but repeatedly questions the reported 2AA by describing TE as sparse/irregular and suggests possible collapse/slower kinetics not clearly supportable from a single still image; also introduces a questionable claim that a day-5 full blastocyst is slower than ideal.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, BMI, diagnosis, semen parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall structure is logical, but there are notable inconsistencies: it first cites 40-55%, later revises to 35-45%, and makes questionable comparisons about day-5 full blastocyst timing and embryo ranking.

Mostly aligned on SET, caution with thin lining, and selective PGT-A discussion, but deviates from standard Gardner interpretation by implying day-5 full blastocyst is suboptimal and overinterpreting morphology from a single image.
Gives practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, cavity evaluation, and future-cycle review; recommendations are useful though some are somewhat generic and not tightly prioritized.
